verdict.rationale: CLI docs show `lms load` can load distinct models with custom identifiers while the server is managed separately via `lms server start/stop`, implying multiple models can be loaded and swapped without a server restart, and the OpenAI-compatible REST API also supports specifying different models per request. However, no evidence explicitly confirms seamless hot-swapping between models without any downtime, and community feedback notes UI friction around model loading/unloading (e.g., no preload/eject controls in headless mode).
